The season was contested by 14 teams due to an expansion in the league system.{{cite news |title=UAE FA increases the number of professional clubs to 14|url=http://proleague.ae/en/news/board-meeting.html|publisher=ufl.ae |date=4 June 2012|access-date=4 June 2012}} [[Al Ain FC|Al Ain]] were the defending champions, having won the previous [[2011–12 UAE Pro-League|2011–12 Pro League]] season. On Thursday, 18 April 2013, Al Ain won their match against [[Dubai CSC|Dubai Club]] which guaranteed them as winners of the 2012–13 Pro League and retained their Pro League trophy. They received their trophy on their last match against [[Al-Nasr SC (Dubai)|Al Nasr]] on Saturday, 25 May 2013. ==Promotion== In June 2012, the UAE FA announced that the league would be expanded into 14 clubs. The two teams that came in the bottom two of the previous campaign – [[Sharjah FC|Sharjah]] and [[Emirates Club]] – would enter a promotion/relegation series with the teams that came third and fourth in the second level – [[Al Dhafra FC|Al Dhafra]] and [[Al-Shaab CSC|Al Shaab]].{{cite web|url=https://www.thenationalnews.com/sport/uae-pro-league-to-expand-to-14-teams-1.410759/|title=UAE Pro League to expand to 14 teams|last=Amith Passela|work=The National|access-date=16 December 2012}} These playoff winners would join [[Kalba FC|Ittihad Kalba]] and [[Dibba Al Fujairah FC|Dibba Al Fujairah]] who came in the top two in the second division. ===Promotion/relegation play-offs=== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=PR |team1=SHB|name_SHB=[[Al-Shaab CSC|Al Shaab]] |team2=DHA|name_DHA=[[Al Dhafra FC|Al Dhafra]] |team3=SHA|name_SHA=[[Sharjah FC|Sharjah]] |team4=EMI|name_EMI=[[Emirates Club|Emirates]] |win_SHB=2|draw_SHB=0|loss_SHB=1|gf_SHB=5|ga_SHB=4 |win_DHA=2|draw_DHA=0|loss_DHA=1|gf_DHA=8|ga_DHA=4 |win_SHA=2|draw_SHA=0|loss_SHA=1|gf_SHA=3|ga_SHA=2 |win_EMI=0|draw_EMI=0|loss_EMI=3|gf_EMI=3|ga_EMI=9 |col_P=#ACE1AF|text_P=Promotion to the 2012–13 UAE Pro-League |result1=P|result2=P |col_R=#FFCCCC|text_R=Relegation to the [[2012–13 UAE Second Division]] |result3=R|result4=R |class_rules=1) points;
